comment:
* Defines the incremental network scan result.
 *
 * This class contains the network scan results. When the user starts a new scan, multiple
 * NetworkScanResult may be returned, containing either the scan result or error. When the user
 * stops an ongoing scan, only one NetworkScanResult will be returned to indicate either the scan
 * is now complete or there is some error stopping it.
 * @hide

variables.name: SCAN_STATUS_PARTIAL
variables.comment: Contains only part of the scan result and more are coming.

variables.name: SCAN_STATUS_COMPLETE
variables.comment: Contains the last part of the scan result and the scan is now complete.

variables.name: scanStatus
variables.comment: The status of the scan, only valid when scanError = SUCCESS.

variables.name: scanError
variables.comment:
* The error code of the scan
     *
     * This is the error code returned from the RIL, see {@link RILConstants} for more details

variables.name: networkInfos
variables.comment: The scan results, only valid when scanError = SUCCESS.
